info.title: API.SH: bioRxiv
info.description: The bioRxiv API from API.SH: public bioRxiv data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
The subject categories bioRxiv files preprints under, with their collection links (use them as `category`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/biorxiv-categories

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Preprints that name a funder (by ROR id) posted in a date window: the preprint records as in /biorxiv/v1/recent, with the funder's name. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/biorxiv-funder

parameters.name: ror
parameters.description: Funder ROR id or ror.org link, e.g. 021nxhr62 (U.S. National Science Foundation), 01cwqze88 (NIH).

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: The last N days (default 30, max 366), when from/to are not given.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pass `next_cursor` back; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Keyword search over bioRxiv preprints: DOI, title, authors, affiliations, abstract, first posting date, year, license, times cited, keywords, grants, links to the published version where known and the bioRxiv link. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/biorxiv-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words (Boolean AND/OR and quoted phrases work).

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Words or a phrase that must be in the title.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pass `next_cursor` back; null on the last page.

get.description:
bioRxiv by month or year: new and revised papers (with running totals), and abstract views, full-text views and PDF downloads (with running totals).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/biorxiv-stats

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
